name: Headless Steam - accepted Valve Android client builds
note: Valve androidarm64 Steam client builds (manifest https://client-update.steamstatic.com/steam_client_linuxarm64, package bins_androidarm64_linuxarm64) that Bannerlator's Headless Steam host (bl-steam-host) may drive. Each row was checked with the host's own structural slot analysis (Bannerlator app/src/main/cpp/bl-steam-host/slot_discovery.cpp: RTTI vtables + method-name references + code fingerprints equal to the device-proven build 1788291500). 'slots' is the analysis result the host cross-checks at runtime; 'sha2' is the package checksum it was verified with (a manifest with a different sha2 is not accepted from this row). Rows are added by the steam-host-watch workflow (source=watcher) or by hand (source=manual). 'revoked' withdraws a build from Headless Steam even if the app has it built in. Nothing here is hosted by us: the app always downloads from Valve's CDN.
